message: 「Yeah, it was」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet, I...」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be... you weren't amused?」

name: Azel
message: 「How do you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Something like this has happened before, hasn't it」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How do you know!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I am a whole year older than you, Azel-chan. Ahem」

name: Azel
message: 「So you are richly experienced as a human being」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, ah, well, ahaha」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I think you'd be better off talking to my big sister about this kind of thing rather than me」

name: Azel
message: 「She cannot be trusted」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm. Does she come across that way... She really pulls through when it counts, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte makes far too many mistakes with her words. Misa is noisy. Nanaka and Synn Sakura are the ones involved. Takahashi is Nanaka's best friend, and Eddie is an idiot"

name: Azel
message: "That leaves only you who seems capable of giving a proper response to a consultation like this」

name: Ria
message: 「What about Melilot-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「She is trustworthy, but she does not observe the daily lives of me, Synn Sakura, and Nanaka」

name: Ria
message: 「When Nanaka-chan and Synn-kun look like they're getting along, it doesn't sit right with you, does it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Correct. It is an irrational emotion」

name: Ria
message: 「Those two have been close right from the start, haven't they?」

name: Azel
message: 「However, in the past, I felt nothing」

name: Ria
message: 「So you only started feeling that way recently?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is correct」

name: Ria
message: 「What about when Nanaka-chan isn't around?」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you mean」

name: Ria
message: 「For example... like thinking about Synn-kun even when he isn't right in front of you」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How do you know!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I knew it」

name: Azel
message: 「He comes to mind unexpectedly, and I also find myself recalling things that man has said」

name: Azel
message: 「Lately, I have become terribly irrational」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no benefit whatsoever in thinking about that man. It is pointless」

name: Azel
message: 「Even though I should simply leave the library once my business is finished, I even find myself obediently waiting for that man to come pick me up. It is illogical behavior」

name: Ria
message: 「What does it feel like while you're waiting?」

name: Azel
message: 「Talking with Melilot is enjoyable」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. Not that... While you're waiting, you're thinking about Synn-kun, aren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「I feel anxious that he might not come. Yet, without any basis, I am convinced that he will. I also look forward to it」

name: Ria
message: 「You're thinking about nothing but Synn-kun」

name: Azel
message: 「...That would be the case. Could it be a mental illness?」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, that might just be love」

name: Azel
message: 「Love?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because you can't help thinking about Synn-kun all the time, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「However, hatred is also a possibility」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you hate Synn-kun, Azel-chan?」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's definitely love」

name: Azel
message: 「But what is love in the first place?」

name: Azel
message: 「Without knowing what it is, I don't know how to act. It is the height of irrationality」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to understand it. Probably」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not something someone teaches you--it's just something you fall into」

name: Azel
message: 「What is love?」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You are asking this one about l-love!?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is correct」

name: Shio
message: 「F-For such subtleties of a maiden's heart, I believe it would be wiser to ask an elder sister well-versed in life rather than a greenhorn such as myself」

name: Azel
message: 「I want to hear what you think」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You say you wish to hear this one's own words!」

name: Shio
message: 「If you insist so earnestly, I cannot refuse. Inexperienced though I am, I shall answer to the utmost of my ability」

name: Shio
message: 「However, I cannot say for certain whether it will be of any use to you」

name: Shio
message: 「To this one, love is roses and sparkles, a maiden's dream, a resonance of souls where hearts communicate merely by gazing into each other's dreamy eyes」

name: Shio
message: 「A bond that overcomes any hardship or tribulation, a flutter that ignites just from walking side by side down an acacia-lined avenue--」

name: Azel
message: 「Be specific」

name: Shio
message: 「What do you mean by specific?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is there someone you find yourself thinking about constantly?」

name: Shio
message: 「In other words, you are asking whether there is someone whose figure comes to my mind whether I am asleep or awake?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is correct」

name: Shio
message: 「There is one such person. The figure I admire is accomplished in both literary and martial arts, the strongest warrior of all. A goal I must one day surpass!」

name: Azel
message: 「What will you do once you surpass them?」

name: Shio
message: 「One yearns precisely because one cannot surpass them」

name: Azel
message: 「So it means being a lifelong loser」

name: Shio
message: 「...Huh? No, that is not it」

name: Azel
message: 「Once you surpass them, you stop yearning, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「...Th-That is somehow different」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, defining love is beyond my humble capabilities! Excuse me!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is love」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well now, that's a terribly abstract question」

name: Azel
message: 「Is love being a lifelong loser?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There might well be some loves like that among them」

name: Azel
message: 「Are there different kinds of love?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The love a person experiences is one of a kind, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「Then there are as many definitions of love as there are people in love?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「More or less, I suppose that's how it goes. Though I don't really know all that well myself」

name: Azel
message: 「Then you can't tell what is love and what isn't. If it can't be defined, it can't be debated」

name: Azel
message: 「Before that, don't speak of things you don't even know!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, don't get so worked up. There's no need to overcomplicate it like that」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying I'll understand if I experience it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's special, different from any other stirring of the heart. That's what love is」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you understand it too?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I've actually had someone I've been head over heels for, for a long, long time」

name: Azel
message: 「A long time means you're a loser?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Because that person isn't a goal I feel I have to surpass」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... So it's different」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The very moment we met, I just knew this person was special to me」

name: Azel
message: 「You just know!? Is there some way to tell them apart?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's simply something you end up knowing」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't get it...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We managed to become good friends, at least. I just can't take things any further than that」

name: Azel
message: 「Why not?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, that's an awfully harsh question」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「After all, nobody likes admitting they don't have the courage」

name: Azel
message: 「What is love」

name: Melilot
message: 「1. Being strongly drawn to a specific person of the opposite sex; also, harboring deep, yearning affection for them. Romantic love」

name: Melilot
message: 「2. Harboring fond attachment to a place, plant, season, or the like」

name: Melilot
message: 「Shall I share the definition from another dictionary as well?」

name: Azel
message: 「No need」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love makes a person strong and weak at the same time」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that how it works」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, who can say? I was merely quoting words spoken about love by people of the past」

name: Azel
message: 「Are there other definitions like that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「People across all times and places have left behind various remarks regarding love」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is being foolish together. Love is like the measles; everyone catches it once. Love is an egotism of two」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is the wisdom of the fool and the folly of the wise. When love comes in, wisdom goes out」

name: Melilot
message: 「True love is like a ghost: everyone talks about it, yet few have seen it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is a lovely flower, and friendship is a sweet fruit. The true essence of love is freedom」

name: Melilot
message: 「The pain of love is far sweeter than any other pleasure」

name: Melilot
message: 「To love is to suffer. If you do not wish to suffer, you must not love. Yet in doing so, you will suffer from not loving」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is much like a shark. It must constantly move forward or else it dies. Love is a struggle between vanity and hope」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is the shortest path from one heart to another. It is a straight line」

name: Melilot
message: 「In every circumstance, romance is endurance. Either you suffer yourself, or you cause another to suffer. Without one of the two, romance cannot exist」

name: Melilot
message: 「Love is a duel. If you glance to the right or to the left, you are defeated. Love is akin to a fever. It is born without regard to one's will, and then perishes」

name: Azel
message: 「How many more are there?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Within the scope of my knowledge, there are still 15,478 famous quotes that speak of love」

name: Azel
message: 「...Just tell me the right answer」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do not know」

name: Azel
message: 「There are that many, and not a single one is the right answer?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone is merely speaking from their own individual subjectivity, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「That's illogical. There should only be one truth」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would it trouble you if there were not just one?」

name: Azel
message: 「It would... I wouldn't know what to do」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san. You are in love, aren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't know... No, that's wrong... Because I...」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What about you, then?! Surely you've experienced a love that was true to you, haven't you? I don't want famous quotes--I want to hear your own words」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have not」

name: Azel
message: 「Why not?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Regrettably, I have never been in love」

name: Azel
message: 「...You don't need to be. It's an awful nuisance」

name: Melilot
message: 「You really are in love, aren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not. Don't jump to conclusions on your own! There's no way I would harbor those kinds of feelings for that man!」

name: Melilot
message: 「He has come to pick you up」

name: Azel
